The comparison cannot yet answer whether the £59 rise meets your stated guardrail, because the **monthly churn <4%** constraint could not be scored.

- The run is only a model-relative, provisional comparison: **Non‑Pro MRR** had no supplied starting value and defaulted to zero; several other inputs are Olumi estimates rather than your evidence.
- The apparent comparison is moderately robust under the tested assumptions, but no option can be put forward because compliance with the churn constraint is unassessed.
- The most decision-relevant uncertainty is how the feature release affects sign-ups and price backlash, including churn; those relationships are provisional.

The next reasoning step is to define what measurable churn quantity the under‑4% limit applies to, so it can be evaluated rather than merely retained as an unscored constraint.
